WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total FROM gender_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT g.gender, g.order_count, CAST(g.order_count AS REAL) / t.total AS share
  FROM gender_counts g
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.gender, s.order_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_average_by
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
